rows.label: tlk47300161_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Hey, Rex! I heard you came back
with a whole bunch of cuties!

rows.label: tlk47300161_01_msg0002
rows.name:
I am jealous... Are salvagers
really that popular in Avaritia?

rows.label: tlk47300161_01_msg0003
rows.name:
I'm not doing too badly myself,
surrounded by former beauties...
Whoa, don't glare at me!

rows.label: tlk47300161_01_msg0101
rows.name:
Everything's nice and quiet
here in Iyasaki. As per usual!

rows.label: tlk47300161_01_msg0102
rows.name:
Sometimes a few stray Kapiiba wander
into the village, but that's about all
the excitement we get round here.

rows.label: tlk47300161_01_msg0103
rows.name:
It may be boring for a young guy like
Rex, but when you're my age, you learn
to appreciate this village.

rows.label: tlk47300161_01_msg0104
rows.name:
My only complaints are that there's
no tavern and no beautiful women...
